actions.action: Unpot and check the roots/bulb to see if it can be saved
Soak the bulb/corm for 30 minutes in water with hydrogen peroxide (5 drops per 7 oz)
Pot the plant in LECA for semi-hydroponics
Keep a small water level at the bottom of the container at all times
Place in a bright spot with indirect light

verdict.reason: The answer treats it as a neglected plant to revive but misses its key warmth and strong-light needs, recommending a LECA semi-hydro setup in indirect light instead of the tropical soil mix, sun/warmth and summer outdoor placement that worked; nothing in it is likely to clearly harm the plant.
